name: Aliso Viejo Town Center
summary: Aliso Viejo Town Center is the primary open-air lifestyle center serving the master-planned community of Aliso Viejo in South Orange County. This well-rated destination offers a convenient mix of shopping, dining, and services in a walkable environment that caters to the area's affluent, family-oriented residents.
demographics: Aliso Viejo Town Center attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from the surrounding master-planned community of Aliso Viejo and neighboring South Orange County areas. The primary visitor base consists of upper-middle-income households with median incomes exceeding $100,000, skewing toward young professionals and families with children aged 25-54. The trade area is characterized by well-educated residents with high homeownership rates who prefer convenient, upscale shopping experiences close to home. Shoppers typically seek quality retailers, diverse dining options, and a walkable outdoor environment that aligns with the community's active, health-conscious lifestyle.
description: Aliso Viejo Town Center serves as the vibrant commercial heart of the master-planned community of Aliso Viejo, California, offering residents and visitors a premier open-air shopping and dining destination. Located on Pacific Park Drive in the heart of South Orange County, this lifestyle center has become an integral gathering place since its development, reflecting the community's commitment to creating walkable, mixed-use environments. The center features a carefully curated mix of national retailers, local boutiques, restaurants, and service providers that cater to the affluent demographics of the surrounding area. With its convenient location just minutes from the 73 Toll Road and Interstate 5, the Town Center provides easy access for shoppers throughout South Orange County while maintaining a neighborhood-focused atmosphere. The property's strong 4.6-star rating from over 1,500 Google reviews reflects its popularity as a well-maintained, accessible shopping destination that successfully balances community needs with quality retail offerings.
